sources.entry: NoiseBuddy - Control the listening mode on your AirPods Pro in the Touch Bar or Menu Bar.

summary.one_liner: NoiseBuddy is a small macOS app that lets you switch AirPods Pro and Beats Solo Pro listening modes (ANC and Transparency) from the Menu Bar or Touch Bar.
summary.what_it_does: The app adds a button to the Mac's Menu Bar and Touch Bar that toggles the listening mode on AirPods Pro or Beats Solo Pro between noise cancelling (ANC) and Transparency with one click. It avoids having to open the volume menu to change these settings. The button only appears when the Mac is using a device that supports listening modes. Where the button appears can be changed in the app's settings screen. The README notes the project no longer works on recent macOS versions, and that similar functionality is now part of AirBuddy.
use_cases: switch AirPods Pro noise cancelling on Mac
toggle transparency mode from menu bar
control Beats Solo Pro listening mode
change AirPods settings from Touch Bar
quick ANC on off on macOS
how_to_run: Download the latest release or build from source (per README).
notable: One-click toggle between ANC and Transparency modes
Shows in both the Menu Bar and the Touch Bar
Button hidden when no compatible listening-mode device is in use
Placement configurable in the settings screen
caveats: README says the project doesn't work in recent versions of macOS
Similar functionality is available in AirBuddy instead
